title: The Missing Star
production_notes: 7 dramatic story acts, 3 speaking identities, suspense through mystery and character growth rather than misleading urgency. Lines are for expressive human-quality voice acting and proper story-driven rigging; TTS generation or a headless scene does not certify an episode.

acts.name: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws
05 A clue that changes the question
07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: High above Starwood, the little northern star had watched over the forest for longer than anyone remembered.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Pip. Wake up. The North Lantern is flickering.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Stars twinkle, Luma. That's what stars do. Unless... wait. That one isn't twinkling.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Its light folded inward, as if a golden eyelid had closed. Then the star disappeared.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: But it was right there. You saw it, didn't you?

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: I saw it. And I think the forest saw it too.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Far below them, every firefly stopped blinking at once. The entire glade held its breath.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Only an hour earlier, the two friends had been racing home through the fern-lined paths of Starwood.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: First one to the old observatory gets the last honey biscuit!
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Last time you said that, you ate the biscuit before I arrived.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: That was a completely different biscuit. A very impatient biscuit.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luma dashed between the trees, her turquoise scarf trailing behind her like a ribbon of sky.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Luma! The little bridge is loose. Slow down!
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: I know every stone of this bridge. Watch!
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The plank beneath her paw tipped with a creak. A shower of pebbles clattered into the stream.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Oh. That stone has definitely moved.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Knowing a path isn't the same as noticing when it changes.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pip offered a steady paw. Luma took it, though her ears dipped with embarrassment.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Tomorrow, I'll listen the first time. I promise.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: You can start tonight.
lines.beat: 02 Earlier that evening — friendship and flaws

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now the promise felt unexpectedly important. The sky had changed, and neither friend knew why.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Someone has to find out where the star went. We can't just sit here.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Then we investigate. But we don't run toward the first mysterious light we see.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As if the forest had heard him, a small golden lantern drifted from the shadows.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: It is the size of a pear. And it's floating by itself!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Look at the glass. There are tiny symbols moving inside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three markings glimmered against the gold: a star, a tree, and two small paw prints.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Two paw prints. It knows we're here.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Or it's waiting for two people. Those aren't always the same thing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lantern waited until they were side by side. Only then did it move.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It guided them between giant roots to a clearing scattered with smooth stones and pale blue flowers.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: I've been through this forest a hundred times. How have I never seen this place?

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Maybe you ran past it a hundred times.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A soft sound came from under a leaf, not a cry exactly, more like a tiny bell caught in the wind.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: The lantern is pointing to that tree. We should follow it.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Wait. Something is stuck under this leaf.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A silver-winged moth had become tangled in the thread of a fallen spiderweb.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: If we stop, the lantern might leave us behind.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Then we'll find it again. Right now, someone here needs help.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pip held the leaf steady. Luma used one careful claw to loosen the fine strands without harming the moth.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: There. You can go. And I'm sorry we almost missed you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The moth rose and circled Luma's scarf, leaving a trail of small blue lights.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Luma. Look behind you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lantern had not gone. It shone brighter than before, and its glass unfolded into a map.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: So it wasn't asking us to hurry. It was asking us to notice.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Some maps only open when you're looking at the right things.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the map, the vanished star was drawn not above the trees, but below their roots.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: That's impossible. Stars belong in the sky.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Maybe it's not a map of where the star belongs. Maybe it's a map of where it went.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: And these circles? They look like ripples in a pond.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Listen. There's a sound beneath them.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three slow knocks moved through the earth, so faint that the flowers barely trembled.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: What if someone took the star?
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: We have one missing star, one strange map, and three knocks. We don't know who did anything.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: You're right. I was already deciding who to blame.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lantern warmed in Luma's paws, and a fourth symbol appeared: a small shield surrounding a spark.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: A shield. Maybe somebody isn't stealing stars. Maybe somebody is protecting them.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Then we need to find out what they're protecting them from.
lines.beat: 05 A clue that changes the question

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The map folded itself into the shape of a leaf and drifted toward the oldest tree in Starwood.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: The Whispering Oak. My grandfather said its roots reach all the way to the underground river.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: He also said not to follow noises under the roots without telling someone where you're going.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Then we mark our path. Two stones at every turn, just like he taught us.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They placed a pale stone beside a dark one. The lantern hummed in approval.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: See? Being careful doesn't mean we're afraid.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: And being brave doesn't mean racing ahead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Between the roots, a doorway appeared where there had only been bark a moment before.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Pip, can you see the writing above it?

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Some of the letters are missing. It says, 'Only the light that is shared...'

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Before he could finish, the lantern split its glow into two beams, one for each friend.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Maybe the rest of the message is ours to discover.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Together, then.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They touched their two beams to the stone. The door opened, and the sound of a distant river rose to greet them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Far below the forest floor, a thousand tiny lights pulsed in time with a heartbeat.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Pip. Those aren't reflections. They're stars.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Then the missing star didn't vanish. It came down here.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A shape moved beyond the water, hidden behind a curtain of roots. The lantern's glow turned suddenly blue.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Who's there? We don't want to hurt anyone.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The three knocks came again. This time they sounded like an answer.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Luma, look at the map. The shield is cracked.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: High above them, another star blinked out. And every underground light flashed together.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Whatever is happening, we're not leaving them alone.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deep in the darkness, a new door began to open. Something on the other side whispered their names.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: How does it know who we are?
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: To be continued: The Path That Moves.
lines.beat: 07 Cliffhanger — answer and a deeper mystery
